F1: Add to calendar downloads a one-off file that does not update. For automatic updates, including corrections and withdrawals, subscribe to the deadline feed. “Checked {DD Mon YYYY}” is SpudSignal’s last check of this entry, not the publication date of the notice. All details as published by the source on that date, with no guarantee of completeness or accuracy. Deadlines, times and documents can change: always check the original notice before acting. The original notice is binding. This list includes no awards, no bidder assessments and no contact data.
F2: Audience labels are guidance on who an item is relevant to. They are not eligibility, and they are not a check that a deadline is currently open. For tenders and funding calls, check the original source for application requirements and deadlines. All shows every entry, including items without an audience label. If you select more than one audience, an entry is shown when it carries any of those labels. These labels combine with other filter groups (type, technical category and country). The same labels filter the map; a pin is labelled only when its source URL is the same URL as an assignment. Audience labels use the same assignment record on the Library, the open-tender list and the map.
